project.name: Vidocq :: Web Extensions :: Servlet (Foy) :: Codegen Bundle
project.description: Companion codegen bundle for vidocq-runtime-foy-servlet-extension. Declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths> whenever the application depends on the Servlet extension. foy-processor generates the web component factories ($$FoyComponent); foy-cdi-vauban carries the build-compatible extensions that Vauban's processor must run at compile time: FoyWebExtension (web components as beans) and, through vauban-webcontexts, the session context.
